thread:
jamie: Heads-up — daily untagged GPU report shows ~12% of last 7d spend (≈ $18k) attributed to the 'realtime-inference' pool but missing team tags. Who owns this pool? Need assignment before EOD so invoices don't misallocate.
putnam: prod or playground? can you paste a couple job ids so we can track them down?
jamie: prod. sample job ids: rig-1a23, rig-1a24, rig-1b00. Query I used: bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'SELECT job_id, labels, project, region, cost FROM billing.gpu_usage WHERE job_id IN ("rig-1a23","rig-1a24","rig-1b00")' — happy to share full query.
billing-bot: AutomatedAlert: Invoice_2026_03 — GPU anomaly detected. Ungrouped GPU spend: $18,234. Suggested actions: run tag_backfill_v2 OR apply alert_snooze(24h). Run /backfill tag_backfill_v2 {job_ids} to start.
sara: I can kick off tag_backfill_v2 now. ETA ~45m depending on shard load. ping me if you want immediate priority.
marta: quick check — looks like entries span two clouds (GCE-us-west1, aws-us-west-2). Backfill must also set cloud.region and cloud.provider tags or we'll still have partial attribution.
ops-lead: Agreed. Also we should prevent new untagged jobs in that pool: suggest a policy change to disallow job creation without required tags in 'realtime-inference'. Can someone open a PR to infra-policy?
jamie: Also — can we temporarily raise the budget alert for realtime-inference from $12k/mo to $25k/mo while backfill runs? It's spamming the oncall channel.
putnam: +1 to temporary bump. billing-bot, can you apply an alert_snooze / budget change for 48h?
billing-bot: Action: alert_snooze applied. Budget realtime-inference alert threshold bumped to $25,000 for 48h by request of @putnam. Current untagged = $18,234.
sara: backfill started: job id 20260323-backfill-77. I'll post the backfill summary when done (rows updated, rows failed).
marta: after backfill completes, please export a sample of 100 records for manual verification. Quick export command: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' "https://atlas.internal/api/billing/export?sample=100&filter=job:rig-1a*" — drop to #finance after you have it.
ops-lead: Tentative ownership: ml-platform-team (owner contact: @marta). @marta please confirm and add to the team budget matrix.
marta: I accept ownership. I'll follow up with PR for job creation guardrails, region tagging in backfill, and a short runbook for finance reconciliation. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
jamie: thanks all — I'll update the reconciliation sheet (link: https://docs.internal/recon/realtime-inference) and attach job ids & backfill summary. :thumbsup: 
putnam: once backfill is verified we should run a retro to close any gaps in onboarding docs. low priority but important.
billing-bot: Note: Invoice hold not applied. If reconciliation needs invoice adjustment, file ticket with billing@redwood and reference Invoice_2026_03.
jamie: copying finance leads for awareness. tagging this thread as action-required.
sara: backfill finished — updated 4,912 rows, 0 failures. sample export uploaded to the recon doc.
marta: verified sample; tags look good. closing the loop from infra side and starting the PR.
ops-lead: thanks team. I'll remove the temporary alert_snooze in 36h if no more noise.
jamie: closing the loop here. will re-open if anything else pops up.
